caption:
The decent human response to learning that h@m@s didn’t 🍇anyone or be-head 👶🏻s on 0ct 7 should be happy. As in, “I’m glad those people didn’t suffer, and those horrific things didn’t actually occur 😊”

Z!0s, however, HATE hearing this, because their entire narrative justification for “war” falls apart.

I understand if you’re J3wish — I hate feeling like I have to censor that word, because it’s NOT a bad word, but IG is strict — seeing people march in protest in favor of a group who committed mass 🍇would be upsetting…

Good news! Most Pals are not in h@m@s! 
And h@m@s DIDN’T do any 🍇 at all!

Isn’t that great?!

I realize it complicates the story you tell yourself, of “Is___l has no choice, after such horrific atrocities,” because said “atrocities” were entirely made up. 😁 

Now that you know, will you change your mind and your story? Or will you do rhetorical flips to find a different justification to keep supporting THAT place over there? 

PS - Isn’t it scary that they’re able to sustain a lie that big for this many years? Really makes you distrust our entire media ecosystem / all Western governments, doesn’t it?
implied_frame: Argues the October 7, 2023 atrocities were 'entirely made up' — no beheaded babies, no rapes, the ~1,200 toll not really civilians — and that Israel itself caused the deaths (Hannibal Directive), with Hamas only intending to take hostages to trade for Palestinian detainees. Verified (A): the '40 beheaded babies' figure was never substantiated and was disavowed (though children WERE killed); the ~1,200 toll included several hundred security personnel (most were civilians); ~5,200 Palestinians, ~1,300 without trial, were in Israeli detention before Oct 7. Disputed (B): the flat 'no sexual violence happened' denial (UN's Patten mission found 'reasonable grounds to believe' rape at >=3 sites while finding specific high-profile cases unfounded — both framings overreach); the 'Israel killed its own / the bombed cars were Israel' Hannibal claims (documented thread, causation disputed); 'Hamas only meant to take hostages, didn't intend to kill' (returned-alive hostages give it some trace, deliberate civilian killings cut against it); the Iraq-WMD/Nayirah 'manufactured consent' framing; and the totalizing 'the atrocities were ENTIRELY made up' (parts are documented real, so the totality is contradicted, not invented-from-nothing). Group C empty: nothing here was demonstrated to have no primary trace. Records written straight; no framing adopted in our voice.
capture_method: Pristine original media + metadata pulled from Instagram's CDN via yt-dlp; delivery webm derived once (VP9 video copied, audio normalized to -16 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP off the source AAC — no re-recording, no in-place re-encode).
video_download_status: Original pulled via yt-dlp (~40.1 MB); delivery ~40.8 MB webm, 169s.
